GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 181.7 (21 Dec 45) ESS-FI
(SCAPIN - 468)
APO 500
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Application of Memorandum Regarding Elimination of War Profits and Reorganization of National Finance (AG 121.7, 24 Nov 45)
1. Reference is made to the Memorandum of the Director of General Affairs, Central Liaison Office, dated 8 December 1945 (C.L.O. No. 958 (2-1)) requesting permission to enact the proposed ordinance attached to the aforementioned Memorandum. The proposed ordinance provides that certain tax relief may be granted to tax payers who suffered serious damage from the storms of the 17th to 19th of September and the 9th to 11th of October 1945.
2. There is no objection to the issuance of the proposed ordinance.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
